title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation

hands.en: Abstract claims six; released assets identify Wuji 1, Wuji 2 beta1, Sharpa Wave and Allegro V3; six-hand accounting remains unresolved.
hands.zh: 摘要称 6 手；公开资产可核验 Wuji 1、Wuji 2 beta1、Sharpa Wave、Allegro V3 四型，六手口径待核。

cross_hand.en: Current 66-task evaluator uses Wuji 1; other hands require integration, with no matched evaluation reported.
cross_hand.zh: 当前 66 任务评测器仅 Wuji 1，其他手复用同任务需适配、未统一评测。

release.en: Benchmark code and 18,000 PhysX demonstrations released; Newton data pending.
release.zh: 基准代码与 PhysX 的 18,000 条示范已发布；Newton 数据待发布。

highlight.en: Demonstration-backed execution and held-out transfer are evaluated separately, including skill composition and deformable interactions.
highlight.zh: 示范学习与保留任务迁移分开评测，覆盖技能组合与可变形交互。
